ideal_equilibrium_limit.scope: Ideal saturation at fixed total number and energy, then adiabatic number-conserving elastic evolution; no Hartree/number-changing/condensate formation calculation.

postproduction_elastic_k00685.limitations: Vacuum-mass collisionless redshift, exact dilute elastic event count, no Bose enhancement/inverse cancellation. If rate is large, actual distribution will change. Standard radiation background after e+e- annihilation only. Ideal equilibrium limit assumes approximate number conservation, not a real-scalar formation proof.

ideal_condensate_limit_class.scope: Instant ideal saturation at production end followed by immediate decoupling; pressureless condensate, collisionless excited bosons, equal primordial adiabatic modes. Not a solution of finite-rate condensation, not valid at cross sections requiring later kinetic decoupling.

results.scope: Ideal saturated single perfectly coupled fluid; no condensate two-fluid modes, mean-field or number-changing; post-e+e- annihilation contribution only. Not a transfer prediction.
